# Iteron ownership registry

<!-- Generated from governance/boundaries.json. Do not edit this file directly. -->

Iteron has one human Owner/Project Lead and a non-fixed number of human maintainers. A maintainer may own one or several boundaries; these rows are responsibility units, not seats. The Owner retains final override authority.

## Enforcement state

- Mode: `bootstrap`
- Project Owner: Jamal Cao (`@fr0m-scratch`)
- Source of truth: [`governance/boundaries.json`](governance/boundaries.json)

> Bootstrap is honest pre-enforcement state: boundaries are claimable, but GitHub cannot request accountable code-owner review until the Owner records explicit public identities and switches the registry to `active`.

## Boundary contracts

### `project-governance` — Project governance

Human authority, maintainership, generated ownership views, and the machine boundary registry.

- Contracts: `owner-override`, `one-human-one-agent`, `dynamic-boundary-registry`, `open-source-license`
- Required checks: `iteron-xtask boundaries check`

### `community-entry` — Community entry

Public project introduction, contribution workflow, pull request shape, and issue intake.

- Contracts: `issue-to-boundary-to-pr`, `human-accountability`
- Required checks: `iteron-xtask boundaries check`

### `security-policy` — Security policy

Public support, vulnerability reporting, disclosure, and security response policy.

- Contracts: `responsible-disclosure`, `security-support-boundary`
- Required checks: `iteron-xtask boundaries check`

### `architecture-roadmap` — Architecture and roadmap

Publicly truthful current architecture, target boundaries, milestones, and limitations.

- Contracts: `current-implementation-truth`, `microkernel-roadmap`
- Required checks: `iteron-xtask boundaries check`

### `documentation-site` — Documentation site

End-user, operator, contributor, and reference documentation; MkDocs presentation, assets, navigation, and reproducible documentation dependencies.

- Contracts: `documentation-build-reproducibility`, `public-navigation-integrity`, `operator-reference-accuracy`
- Required checks: `python -m pip install --require-hashes -r requirements-docs.lock`, `mkdocs build --strict --clean`, `iteron-xtask boundaries check`

### `build-release` — Build and release

Workspace membership, dependency locks, trusted automation, installer, packaging, artifacts, and release gates.

- Contracts: `workspace-dependency-baseline`, `required-rust-gates`, `generated-boundary-drift`, `verified-release-supply-chain`, `atomic-no-sudo-install`
- Required checks: `cargo fmt --all -- --check`, `iteron-xtask boundaries check`, `release-tools/validate.sh`

### `protocol-compat` — Protocol compatibility

Versioned submissions, events, identity, trust, permission, message, and tool contracts.

- Contracts: `runtime-protocol`, `durable-event-schema`, `permission-schema`, `sqeq-version-lockstep`
- Required checks: `cargo test -p iteron-protocol --locked`, `iteron-xtask boundaries check-base --base <rev>`, `iteron-xtask boundaries check-pr --base <rev>`

### `kernel-reduction` — Kernel reduction and driver

The pure turn reducer, its closed command/action vocabulary, and the bounded agent-loop driver that routes action requests to injected ports.

- Contracts: `pure-reduction`, `bounded-queues`
- Required checks: `cargo test -p iteron-kernel reducer --locked`, `cargo test -p iteron-kernel driver --locked`

### `kernel-runtime` — Kernel runtime

Turn state machine, admission, budgets, orchestration execution, and frontend event seam.

- Contracts: `turn-state-machine`, `bounded-run`, `single-writer`
- Required checks: `cargo test -p iteron-kernel --locked`

### `kernel-effects` — Kernel effects

Effect admission, durable intent ordering, terminal or unknown outcome, and reconciliation.

- Contracts: `intent-execute-terminal`, `unknown-effect-block`
- Required checks: `cargo test -p iteron-kernel effect --locked`

### `telemetry-export` — Telemetry export sink

Operator-authorised OTel egress: user-config-only endpoint, brokered network effect, bounded and reaped like any other world effect.

- Contracts: `trusted-hook-origin`, `bounded-hook-process`
- Required checks: `cargo test -p iteron-cli telemetry --locked`

### `kernel-hooks` — Runtime lifecycle hooks

CLI-hosted lifecycle hook admission, bounded child processes, environment policy, and hook evidence.

- Contracts: `trusted-hook-origin`, `bounded-hook-process`
- Required checks: `cargo test -p iteron-cli hooks --locked`

### `record-core` — Record iteron

Append-only journal, hash chain, replay, checkpoint, recovery, and redaction.

- Contracts: `append-only-record`, `hash-chain`, `torn-tail-recovery`, `secret-redaction`
- Required checks: `cargo test -p iteron-record --locked`

### `record-sessions` — Record sessions

Session metadata, listing, fork lineage, resume projection, and tenant scoping.

- Contracts: `fork-aware-replay`, `tenant-scoped-session`
- Required checks: `cargo test -p iteron-record session --locked`

### `observability` — Observability

Usage ledger, cost truth, runtime metrics, and mergeable child-run accounting.

- Contracts: `cost-state`, `usage-ledger`, `no-invented-price`
- Required checks: `cargo test -p iteron-obs --locked`

### `scheduler` — Scheduler

Retry, backoff, and bounded concurrency governor policy.

- Contracts: `bounded-retry`, `bounded-concurrency`, `pre-stream-retry-only`
- Required checks: `cargo test -p iteron-sched --locked`

### `provider-core` — Provider iteron

Provider trait, route identity, errors, catalog, health, capabilities, and shared stream parsing.

- Contracts: `provider-port`, `catalog-truth`, `typed-provider-error`
- Required checks: `cargo test -p iteron-provider --locked`

### `provider-adapters` — Provider adapters

Anthropic Messages, OpenAI-compatible Chat, and OpenAI Responses wire adapters.

- Contracts: `stream-to-turn-result`, `native-state-scope`, `effort-application`
- Required checks: `cargo test -p iteron-provider --locked`

### `mcp-interop` — MCP interoperability

MCP process lifecycle, framing, tools, deadlines, and definite or unknown outcomes.

- Contracts: `mcp-framing`, `bounded-mcp-lifecycle`, `unknown-external-effect`
- Required checks: `cargo test -p iteron-mcp --locked`

### `language-server-lifecycle` — Language server lifecycle

LSP framing, handshake state, restart budget, document versions, and bounded in-flight requests.

- Contracts: `bounded-lsp-framing`, `versioned-diagnostics`
- Required checks: `cargo test -p iteron-lsp --locked`

### `workspace-change-set` — Workspace change set

Complete staged/unstaged/untracked classification, unified-diff hunks, destructive-op guard and restore preview.

- Contracts: `complete-change-truth`
- Required checks: `cargo test -p iteron-changeset --locked`

### `status-surface` — Status surface

Status-line field allowlist, honest unknowns, cell-accurate width and injection-safe terminal title.

- Contracts: `no-control-sequence-injection`, `unknown-is-not-zero`
- Required checks: `cargo test -p iteron-statusline --locked`

### `support-bundle` — Support bundle

Deterministic, allowlisted, redacted diagnostic bundle with an unforgeable grammar and no transmit path.

- Contracts: `allowlisted-environment-capture`, `deterministic-redacted-bundle`
- Required checks: `cargo test -p iteron-support --locked`

### `plugin-marketplace` — Plugin marketplace

Fail-closed signature gating, monotonic versions, retained-artifact rollback and honest offline staleness.

- Contracts: `fail-closed-signature-gate`, `no-silent-downgrade`
- Required checks: `cargo test -p iteron-marketplace --locked`

### `context-core` — Context iteron

Compaction, instruction trust, source access, outline, and stable context estimation.

- Contracts: `untrusted-instruction-framing`, `bounded-context`, `compaction-policy`
- Required checks: `cargo test -p iteron-ctx --locked`

### `context-knowledge` — Context knowledge

Memory and skill discovery, trust, storage, bounded recall, and progressive disclosure.

- Contracts: `memory-provenance`, `bounded-recall`, `skill-progressive-disclosure`
- Required checks: `cargo test -p iteron-ctx --locked`

### `agent-catalog` — Agent catalog

Agent definitions, discovery, trust, read-only tool filtering, and catalog diagnostics.

- Contracts: `read-only-agent-authority`, `agent-definition-trust`
- Required checks: `cargo test -p iteron-agents --locked`

### `agent-orchestration` — Agent orchestration

Task classification, decomposition, deterministic Fan and Reduce policy, and workflow data.

- Contracts: `single-writer-fan-reduce`, `declaration-order-reduction`
- Required checks: `cargo test -p iteron-agents --locked`

### `evolution-control` — Evolution control

Offline policy, trajectory, evidence, and promotion contracts without runtime authority.

- Contracts: `no-runtime-activation`, `immutable-policy-reference`, `governed-promotion`
- Required checks: `cargo test -p iteron-evolve --locked`

### `sandbox` — Sandbox

Platform confinement, child environment, process groups, output bounds, and egress policy.

- Contracts: `selectable-workspace-confinement`, `operator-selected-egress`, `bounded-child-process`
- Required checks: `cargo test -p iteron-sandbox --locked`

### `tools-core` — Tools iteron

Tool registry, capability and purity coupling, filesystem, edit, and Git tools.

- Contracts: `tool-abi`, `host-path-authority`, `purity-capability-coupling`
- Required checks: `cargo test -p iteron-tools --locked`

### `tools-execution` — Tools execution

Code execution, external web egress, deadlines, output bounds, and external effects.

- Contracts: `selectable-code-confinement`, `ssrf-boundary`, `external-effect-classification`
- Required checks: `cargo test -p iteron-tools --locked`

### `tools-context` — Tools context

Memory and skill tool adapters that preserve source trust and progressive disclosure.

- Contracts: `memory-tool-trust`, `skill-tool-read-only`
- Required checks: `cargo test -p iteron-tools --locked`

### `verification` — Verification

Oracle strength, sandboxed test oracle, deterministic candidate ranking, and veto rules.

- Contracts: `oracle-strength`, `strong-veto`, `deterministic-selection`
- Required checks: `cargo test -p iteron-verify --locked`

### `workflow-engine` — Workflow engine

Deterministic workflow script host: agent fan-out, journal, cache keys, and progress events.

- Contracts: `bounded-agent-fanout`, `deterministic-replay`, `journal-durability`
- Required checks: `cargo test -p iteron-workflow --locked`

### `evaluation` — Evaluation

Benchmark tasks, fixed-model component toggles, scoring, and reliability evidence.

- Contracts: `fixed-model-comparison`, `ground-truth-check`, `honest-quality-claim`
- Required checks: `cargo check -p iteron-eval --all-targets --locked`

### `tunability-registry` — Tunable registry and pure resolver

Versioned registry plus a deterministic provider-free evaluator for explicit frozen inputs, typed attested constraints, atomic failure reports, and bounded redacted explanations. Resolution remains a non-authoritative simulation until the runtime separately admits and binds it.

- Contracts: `stable-semantic-family-identity`, `typed-value-domain`, `canonical-registry-digest`, `exact-registry-input-identity`, `deterministic-pure-resolution`, `fail-closed-attested-constraints`, `atomic-resolution-failure`, `bounded-redacted-explain`, `non-authoritative-metadata`, `runtime-remains-sole-authority`, `fixed-invariant-nontrainability`
- Required checks: `cargo test -p iteron-tunables --locked`, `cargo run --locked -p iteron-xtask -- tunables check`

### `cli-host` — CLI host

Composition root, trusted configuration, provider routing, commands, MCP wiring, run lifecycle, and provider-free local simulation adapters.

- Contracts: `trusted-config-precedence`, `runtime-composition`, `provider-selection`, `provider-free-tunables-simulation`, `stable-bounded-simulation-output`
- Required checks: `cargo test -p iteron-cli --locked`

### `cli-tui` — CLI TUI

Interactive state, input routing, composer, permission UX, sessions, bounded transcript inspection/export, safe clipboard effects, terminal lifecycle, and PTY behavior.

- Contracts: `single-enter-input`, `terminal-restoration`, `permission-decision-surface`, `semantic-transcript`, `streaming-redaction`
- Required checks: `cargo test -p iteron-cli tui --locked`, `cargo test -p iteron-cli --test tui_pty --locked`

### `cli-render` — CLI rendering

Semantic blocks, markdown, syntax highlighting, layout, theme, and cell-width correctness.

- Contracts: `terminal-cell-bounds`, `semantic-transcript`, `accessible-theme`
- Required checks: `cargo test -p iteron-cli --locked`

### `cli-output` — CLI machine output

Text, JSON, stream-JSON, event scrubbing, exit codes, and machine-readable result contracts.

- Contracts: `machine-output-schema`, `stable-exit-code`, `streaming-redaction`
- Required checks: `cargo test -p iteron-cli output --locked`

## Cross-cutting invariant overlays

An overlay adds review responsibility without becoming a second primary path owner.

| Overlay | Status | Independent review | Reviewers | Trigger paths |

## Claiming or changing ownership

1. Open an ownership-claim issue naming the boundary, proposed human primary, reviewer or backup, adjacent contracts, and handoff plan.
2. The Owner confirms the appointment. An agent cannot claim, approve, inherit, or exercise a human boundary.
3. Update `governance/boundaries.json`, run `cargo run --locked -p iteron-xtask -- boundaries generate`, and submit both generated files.
4. Run `cargo run --locked -p iteron-xtask -- boundaries check`. Active enforcement requires every critical boundary and independent overlay to be assigned; critical primaries and affected primaries cannot self-review.
5. A person may claim several coherent boundaries. Maintainer count is never encoded as a quota.
